name: ANSI/IEEE Audible siren form
summary: IEEE-library form of audible siren: a siren indication identifies an audible alarm output with the documented operating role.
description: This reference locates audible siren in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous family. A siren indication identifies an audible alarm output with the documented operating role. The public library uses HAN1S for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
